parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

parameters.name: LicenseCode
parameters.description: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which you want to grant a license.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.
